School Committee of the Whole.check: review: "Committee of the Whole" is a procedural term for the full School Committee meeting as a single committee. "Junta de Educación Plena" does not convey this and reads as a type of board. It should be something like "Pleno de la Junta de Educación" or "Comité en pleno de la Junta Escolar".
